issues.description: Captures any issues that occurred while deserializing from filesystem

intermediatePath.description: Indicates the intermediate file path, where the telemetry mapping per app csv will be published,

destPaths.description: Indicates the list of paths where the combined telemetry mapping csv will be published,

enabled.description: Flag to control the enablement of the telemetry label mapping export feature.

clusterMappingExportPrefix.description:
Indicates the file name to which the combined csv data is published.
Final file structure will be {link @TelemetryMappingExporter.Config#baseDirPath}_<Time stamp>

latestPublishedClusterMappingFileName.description:
Indicates the most recent date suffixed file name to which the combined csv data is published.
Final file structure will be {link @TelemetryMappingExporter.Config#baseDirPath}_<Time stamp>

title: This type provides config related to Telemetry Mapping
